title: Control API restore
description: I0: what the control API's POST /restore takes, an operator action: restore one of a world's backups. The control plane validates it against this contract and checks the backup against the names the world's runtime last reported (G6), then hands it in the world's generation (B1), unless another change to that world waits, and the runtime makes it wait until no players are online, or until vhd apply --disconnect-players confirms it. It answers 202 with contracts/control.restore-reply.schema.json: the same id again for a request still under way for the same world and backup, and a new id for another backup, whose restore replaces the one under way. Each refusal changes nothing. It answers 411 or 413, with no body, for a missing, empty or oversize Content-Length, nothing for a body cut short, 500 for a fault of its own, after which vhd status shows whether it keeps the restore, and otherwise {"error": <why>}: 400 for a request that breaks this contract, 404 for a world the install does not run, 409 for a backup the runtime has not reported, 503 while there is no generation yet, or while the install's state stays busy (vhd apply, or the control plane's own pass) past the request's wait.

backup.description: The backup to restore: its name, the time it was taken, in UTC, as vhd backups lists it.
